description: cvrt-lang 0.10.0+: import a lang_export file from this machine (POST /import { document, apply }). A DRY RUN unless apply is true: the report shows what would change and writes nothing. Refused before any request: a file that is not a cvrt-lang export (format cvrt-lang-export, version 1, sections), so no other local JSON is ever sent, and files or bodies over 32 MB. Strings keep manual translations, object links only where id, type, subtype and slug still match; an export of another site gets the warning other_site.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the export JSON on this machine (at most 32 MB)

name: lang_import
